_comment: RGBMatrixFX layout pack (example/template). Copy to ~/.local/share/rgbmatrixfx/layouts/<something>.json, edit, then run: systemctl --user restart rgbmatrixfx-engine (or replug the device). Data only: nothing here is executed. Format: docs/LAYOUTS.md
name: Example 60% keyboard (ANSI)

match._comment: Matches if the USB product id OR a name substring (case-insensitive) matches. Find both in Help > About > System info.
name: Example 60% Keyboard

_comment_keys: Key -> [row, col] in the device's OpenRazer matrix. Keys: RGBMatrixFX/evdev names (W, SPACE, LEFTSHIFT, KP5, F1...), KEY_ names (KEY_W) or evdev codes ("17"). Keys you leave out stay dark for ripples; effects still light every cell.
_comment_logo: Optional: the logo LED's cell (keyboard). Leave out if the device has none.
_comment_zones: Mouse packs only ("kind": "mouse"): "zones": {"logo": [[0, 1]], "scroll": [[0, 0]]}. Cells not listed in a zone are not driven.
